observations.behavior: Adds a new wrapper function read_rows_with_deadline and a new exception MSSQLRowReadTimeoutError, and passes the deadline to the row-read path.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent a row-read from hanging indefinitely when SQL Server does not return a batch before the configured deadline, potentially recovering from a transient network or server issue without requiring a full retry of the entire import. The wrapper converts the generic timeout into a domain-specific error that can be distinguished from other failures.
